description: Verify that DUT-emit UDP datagram carries the caller-specified Source IP Address (RFC 768 'User Interface' MUST)
approach:
[Objective]
The send primitive must carry the caller's src_ip to the wire. Multi-homed hosts often want to choose which interface (and therefore which IP) the datagram leaves on; the user interface must respect that choice.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester → DUT: send-UDP request via the user interface (src_ip = X)

2. Observation:
   • DUT → Tester: UDP datagram
     - src_ip == X   ← key check (also implicitly checks src_port to keep the captured tuple unambiguous)

[Pass condition]
DUT-emitted UDP carries src_ip = X.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_wrong_src_ip_or_port — DUT emitted UDP with a different src_ip (or wrong src_port)
• Fail_timeout — DUT did not emit any UDP within the listen window

verdicts.Pass: DUT-emitted UDP carries the requested src_ip — normal
verdicts.Fail_wrong_src_ip_or_port: DUT emitted UDP with the wrong user-interface src_ip
verdicts.Fail_timeout: No DUT-originated UDP within the listen window
